QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Evacuation Prep
QuestInfo.0: Chief Kan and Peytour are talking intently to one another in low voices.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Kan and Peytour were trying to figure out how to safely transport the injured to a town across the river. If you can repair the damaged caravan wagon just outside town, they might make it. Peytour is going to retrieve the wagon while you collect wood for the repairs.
QuestInfo.2: Now that he has the materials he needs, Peytour is going to repair the caravan wagon and has asked you to help the villagers prepare to leave.

default.0: I know it's a lot to ask, but I need 50 Sturdy Pieces of Wood.
